'''Virtual Modern''' is the [[Players Committee]] Virtual-card era from the [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]] onward. The Advocate Council announced the Reset on 25 July 2014.<ref name="reset-announce">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/reset-of-standard-format/ Reset of Standard Format], Advocate Council (byline darkjediknight11), Players Committee (25 July 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170306155342/http://www.starwarsccg.org/reset-of-standard-format/ Internet Archive, 6 March 2017]</ref> [[Virtual Set 0]] and [[Virtual Set D]] are dated 24 September 2014. Printable overlays are [[V-slips]]. The full constructed pool is [[Open]] (Players Committee '''Standard''').<ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

== Sets ==

The numbered sequence begins with [[Virtual Set 0]], released after the [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]], and continues through [[Virtual Set 27]]. [[Virtual Set D]] collects defensive shields. [[Virtual Set P]] collects premium cards released in two waves. Printable cards are available as [[V-slips]].<ref name="modern-releases">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual Slips / Files]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113162743/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/virtual-slips-20261113.html Internet Archive], Players Committee, release dates and printable sets (checked 13 November 2026).</ref>

The dates below are the original release dates. Card totals count distinct Light Side and Dark Side entries in the official rosters on 13 November 2026, with alternate images and both faces of a card counted once. Later additions, replacements and withdrawals can change a roster. The Set P wave rows instead count the four and three original cards of each release; the other premium items and alternate-image presentations remain catalogued on [[Virtual Set P]].

=== Supplemental demonstration material ===

The Players Committee also publishes basic demonstration decks and two expansions for learning the game. The premium demonstration cards are included in [[Virtual Set P]]. The combined Basic Decks plus Expansions download contains the same demonstration products.<ref name="modern-releases" />

== Organized play ==

Championship constructed from 2015 uses [[Open]].<ref name="list">[[List of SWCCG tournaments]]</ref> The [[2014 World Championship]] in Toronto was the last circuit event on [[Premiere - Virtual Block 9.1]]. The same weekend ran a [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]] in Open, won by [[Keith Brown]].

== Online play ==

[[GEMP]] is the current browser table, created by [[Troy Biesterfeld]]. [[Holotable]] version 0.9.9 handled the Reset in December 2014.
